item.title: Haskell for all: Beyond agentic coding
item.description:
📝 Both studies and developer testimonials show that agentic coding breaks flow and keeps developers in an idle/interruptible holding pattern more than ordinary coding. Calm technology Calm technology is a design discipline that promotes flow state in tools that we build. tools should create and enhance calm (thus the name: calm technology) A state of calm helps users enter and maintain flow state.
🔗 Read more: https://haskellforall.com/2026/02/beyond-agentic-coding

item.title: Homeland Security Spying on Reddit Users
item.description:
